<!-- pr-reviewer: 3c4e3b7b80488e161e599d739e2e3cb48cb01ae8 -->
Needs changes before merge: one missing line in the body (a process-file change). No code problems found.

What looks good:
- The acknowledgment is self-validating: `stock_source::incoming_stock_source` re-reads the mark, the model fingerprint and an independent stock print, so a stale or moved source cannot keep it alive (`crates/app/src/stock_source.rs`).
- `SetStockSourceOnly::with_inherited_deficits` validates at construction: needs `on`, needs a from-model stock with a source model and geometry, and refuses a stock with no geometry to acknowledge (`crates/app/src/commands/stock_source_only.rs`).
- The session-only acknowledgment is dropped at project load in the same `check_and_apply` arm that re-reads the mark (`crates/app/src/project/apply.rs`), and the pinning test proves a reopened project blocks again.
- The walk now takes its steps from the program's own ops when nothing is planned, so a probe-only program is judged on the setup it runs in rather than the first setup's stock (`crates/app/src/stock_sim_carry.rs`, `step_setups`). A program with a torch or wire, or an undercut pass, is refused the note and keeps the full gate, which is the conservative reading.
- The 16 pinning tests (`crates/app/tests/keep_law/incoming_stock_deficits.rs`) cover both the acknowledgment and its refusals: cut-into still blocks, probe-in-another-setup still blocks, clean stock beside an idle deficient setup posts, a probe-only program across the wrong setup refuses, and the undercut keeps the full gate.

Results merged with main (local, Linux; trial merge with current main 78199de0e - clean, `mergeable: MERGEABLE`):
- Build of `camcraft-app` (test binaries): passed, exit 0.
- `keep_law` (incl. `incoming_stock_deficits`): 47 passed, 0 failed (the 16 new tests pass: 16/16).
- `posting`: 17 passed, 0 failed (merged tree).
- `camcraft-app` lib unit tests for the touched module: 2 passed, 0 failed (`stock_sim::incoming::tests::unchanged_deficits_do_not_hide_fresh_or_deepened_gouges`, `a_different_lattice_keeps_the_full_verdict`).
- `clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: NOT RUN - the host is overloaded and the shared cap of one review build is in effect while the kernel gate and a runner job are active. Re-run before merging.
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`): NOT RUN - same reason. Note the PR body says the light lane belongs to the independent upstream review; it is not recorded here as a pass.

Targeted tests (step 5):
- Example catalog: not run - no post or toolpath change (this is a stock-sim/verification-gate change, not a post engine or toolpath change).
- Light lane: not run (see above). A red light lane would be a note, not a blocker; it is absent here, and the author's body defers it to the upstream review.
- P1 targeted heavy step: not owed - this is P3 (posting safety check), not P1, and the author's body does not claim a heavy step.

Requested before merge:
1. The delta commit 3c4e3b7b changes `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` (line 119: the `set_raw_stock_only` row gains `report_inherited_deficits`) - a process file - and the PR body has no `Process change: yes` line. Add the line (the merging session will bump `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`; do not edit that file in this PR). One line in the body, no code change.

Questions / notes (not blocking):
- `crates/app/src/stock_sim_carry.rs`, `cuts_nothing_across_setups`: the not-judged refusal line appends "the operation checks do not verify the stock under probes or torches across this setup change" for any empty plan across setups. A waterjet-only program across setups is refused through this same arm, but the appended clause names probes/torches rather than the waterjet (which is what actually skipped the plan). The post is still refused either way, so this is wording, not a wrong verdict - worth a sentence in the PR notes if you want the line precise.
- `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` documents the new parameter but the "124 tools" count is unchanged (the tool was extended, not added), which matches the live list. No action needed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
